title: SOC Shenzhen Overseas Study Trip
text: During my semester break, I joined Singapore Polytechnic's School of Computing Overseas Study Trip to Shenzhen, China. We visited technology companies like Sandstone and VoiceAI, technology exhibitions and Shenzhen Technology University. I learnt a lot about China's technology landscape and made some new friends along the way!
